datasheet.title: 8NS8-RACK-MOUNT-PDU data sheet (8-Outlet Horizontal Rack Mount PDU, 1U)

description: StarTech.com 8NS8-RACK-MOUNT-PDU, a 1U horizontal switched rack PDU, 120 V, 15 A, single phase. A black steel box with a built-in mounting bracket at each end. The front carries a 15 A push-to-reset circuit breaker at the left and the maker's logo. It also carries eight numbered rocker switches, one per outlet. Each switch is lit red while its outlet is on and sits under a removable cover. The rear carries eight NEMA 5-15R outlets, numbered 8 to 1 from the left as seen from the rear. A fixed 8 ft (2.4 m) cord with a NEMA 5-15P plug leaves at the right.

gaps.note: the guide draws two slotted holes in each bracket and gives no dimension; the guide says the unit takes "4x Cabinet Screws" and "4x Cage Nuts" (not included). Only the flush position is named.
the data sheet's 19.0 in length includes the brackets and the body between the folds is read off the guide's diagram (440 mm, about 21 mm of bracket each side).
the guide's two diagrams give outlet pitches of 38.8 mm (rear) and 38.0 mm (the switches in front); no document prints a figure.

each switch stands on the front and its outlet on the rear, and a lamp is bound to an outlet only within one view, so the switches are not tied to their outlets by `for`. The guide numbers each switch and each outlet 1 to 8 and says the switch "Turns the Corresponding Outlet On or Off"; the numbers are the only tie, and the wiring order is not stated.
gaps.wanted: nothing further from the vendor; the library would need a cross-view lamp binding.

gaps.note: no document shows the top, the bottom or an end straight on; the data sheet photograph sees the top and the right end at a steep angle and shows ventilation on neither.
gaps.wanted: straight-on photographs of the top, the bottom and an end, with a scale.

name: 8ns8-rack-mount-pdu

breaker.note: datasheet - "15A Circuit Breaker ... self-tripping and resettable"; guide component 1: "Turns-Off All Power, in the Event of a Power Surge, 15A Tripping Point, Push to Reset". Drawn with common/breaker-push-reset@1, which is a hex nut with a round plunger; the guide's diagram draws a round ring with a dark centre, so the nut's shape differs from the figure.

capability.note: datasheet - each outlet "features an individual illuminated rocker switch", so `outlet-switching: true`; nothing is metered (no meter, display or network port is listed), so `metering-scope: none` and the class is switched.

chassis.note: datasheet - 8NS8-RACK-MOUNT-PDU data sheet, page 2: "Product Length 19.0 in [48.2 cm]", "Product Width 3.8 in [95.5 mm]", "Product Height 1.7 in [44 mm]", "Weight of Product 4.4 lb [2.0 kg]", "U Height 1U", "Color Black", "Material Steel". The length includes the built-in brackets; the body between the folds is read off the guide's diagram as 440 mm (ESTIMATED; the bracket is about 21 mm each side). The width is read as the depth of a horizontal unit; the sheet does not say which axis it means.

front.note: photo-measured - millimetres from the body's left edge and top, read off the guide's front diagram (no scale printed, see method). Breaker centre 29.9 across, 22.0 down. Logo centre 85.5 across. Switch covers are 24.0 x 38.8, centres at 140.2 across then every 38.0 mm, tops 4.9 down; the numerals 1 to 8 stand 16.9 left of each cover's centre, 9.6 down.

input.note: datasheet - "Built-in 8ft. (2.4m) NEMA 5-15P power cord", "Connector 1 NEMA 5-15 (125V AC, 15A)", "Input Voltage 120 AC", "Regulatory Derated Input Current (North America) 12A", "Maximum Total Current 15A". Guide page 1, component 4: "Built-in Power Cable, NEMA 5-15P Connector, 125V AC / 15A".

method.note: ESTIMATED where a position is read off a figure that prints no scale. Positions on the front and the rear are read off the two diagrams on page 1 of the 8NS8-RACK-MOUNT-PDU Quick-Start Guide (Manual Revision September 5, 2024), "Product Diagram, Front" and "Rear", as fractions of the 482.6 mm rack face each diagram spans from ear tip to ear tip (4103 px at 400 dpi, 8.50 px per mm; the body between the ears is 3742 px, 440 mm, and the face 374 px, 44 mm). The two diagrams are drawn to slightly different outlet pitches (38.0 mm across the switches and 38.8 mm across the outlets), so each face is read on its own and the two disagree by up to 3 mm where a switch stands in front of its outlet. The data sheet's photograph on page 1 is an angled view and is used for colour only.

outlets.note: datasheet - data sheet, page 1 and 2: "8x NEMA 5-15R outlets", "Number of Power Outlets 8", "rear facing outlets"; guide page 1, component 3: "Outlets (x8) NEMA 5-15R Connector 125V AC / 15A". std/nema-5-15r@1 is the library's 5-15R face, borrowed from the 5-20R, so the outlets are that part's size; the guide's diagram draws each in a block about 27.8 x 26.5.

rear.note: photo-measured - millimetres from the body's left edge as seen from the rear, read off the guide's rear diagram. Outlet 8 centre at 30.6 across, then every 38.8 mm to outlet 1 at 302.2, all 22.2 down (re-measured on the guide's rear diagram, 9.3 to 35.8 mm below the body's top for each block); the numerals stand 19.0 left of each centre and 9.0 down. Cord relief centre at 413.0 across, 23.7 down.
